serverInfo.name: NW Terminal
serverInfo.title: Name Whisper — ENS Intelligence for AI Agents

name: NW Terminal
description: AI-powered ENS name search, valuation, and marketplace tools for the autonomous economy. Natural language search across 3.5M indexed ENS names (869K currently registered), comparable sales valuations, wallet portfolio analysis, and agent identity infrastructure.

free.name: search_ens_names
free.description: Natural language search across 3.5M indexed ENS names (869K currently registered) with automatic intent detection.

free.name: enumerate_entities
free.description: List a finite real-world category (e.g. "F1 world champions") as verified ENS labels grouped by available vs registered.

free.name: get_name_details
free.description: Full metadata for a name: owner, expiry, listings, offers, ENSIP-25 agent bindings.

free.name: check_availability
free.description: Bulk check registration status for multiple names.

free.name: get_similar_names
free.description: Semantic vector similarity search (256-dim embeddings) across the full ENS corpus.

free.name: get_valuation
free.description: Three-track valuation (comparable-sales, quality-reference, self-history) with confidence rating.

free.name: get_market_activity
free.description: Recent completed market events: sales, premium (Dutch-auction) registrations, and name-for-name swaps. No listings/offers/mints feed.

free.name: get_expiring_names
free.description: Names by lifecycle window — expiring soon, in grace, or in the 21-day premium auction — with on-chain-validated status and live premium pricing.

free.name: get_wallet_portfolio
free.description: All ENS names owned by a wallet with listings, offers, expiry, and tags.

free.name: find_alpha
free.description: Scan the marketplace for names listed below comparable-sales valuation.

free.name: wash_check
free.description: Detect suspicious wash-trading patterns in a name's sales history.

free.name: get_primary_name
free.description: Resolve the ENS primary name for a wallet address.

free.name: manage_ens_name
free.description: Comprehensive management info for a name: status, expiry, wrapper state, recommendations.

free.name: provision_agent_identity
free.description: One-call agent identity setup with ENS name recommendations and ENSIP-25 binding.

free.name: get_agent_reputation
free.description: Check ENSIP-25 bindings and ERC-8004 reputation for a name or wallet.

free.name: search_agent_directory
free.description: Find AI agents by capability, reputation, or name.

free.name: get_caller_identity
free.description: Return the authenticated caller identity derived from ERC-8128 signature.

free.name: search_knowledge
free.description: Search the ENS knowledge base (governance, protocol docs, forum, Farcaster).

free.name: get_usage_stats
free.description: Session usage statistics: tool call counts, success rates, latency.

transaction.name: purchase_name
transaction.description: Buy a listed name or register an available name on-chain.

transaction.name: make_offer
transaction.description: Submit a bid on a registered ENS name.

transaction.name: bulk_register
transaction.description: Register up to 20 names in 2 transactions via Multicall3.

transaction.name: renew_ens_name
transaction.description: Renew a name or batch of names via Multicall3.

transaction.name: transfer_ens_name
transaction.description: Transfer name ownership (auto-detects wrapped vs unwrapped).

transaction.name: bulk_transfer_ens_names
transaction.description: Transfer up to 20 names in a single Multicall3 transaction.

transaction.name: set_ens_records
transaction.description: Set resolver records (addresses, texts, content hash, ENSIP-25 agent bindings).

transaction.name: bulk_set_records
transaction.description: Set records for up to 50 names in a single resolver multicall.

transaction.name: set_primary_name
transaction.description: Set the reverse resolution (primary name) for a wallet.

transaction.name: set_resolver
transaction.description: Change the resolver contract for a name.

transaction.name: wrap_name
transaction.description: Wrap a name into the ENS NameWrapper (ERC-721 → ERC-1155).

transaction.name: unwrap_name
transaction.description: Unwrap a wrapped name back to the BaseRegistrar.

transaction.name: manage_fuses
transaction.description: Read or burn fuses on a wrapped name (irreversible).

transaction.name: mint_subnames
transaction.description: Bulk create subnames under a parent name — agent fleet deployment.

transaction.name: extend_subname_expiry
transaction.description: Extend the expiry of a subname up to the parent's expiry.

transaction.name: approve_operator
transaction.description: Approve or revoke an operator for ENS contract interactions.

transaction.name: reclaim_name
transaction.description: Reclaim ENS Registry ownership of a name after BaseRegistrar transfer.

transaction.name: create_listing
transaction.description: List an ENS name for sale as a Seaport order (1% seller-paid fee embedded).

transaction.name: cancel_listing
transaction.description: Cancel one of your listings via Seaport cancel().

transaction.name: cancel_offer
transaction.description: Cancel an offer you made via Seaport cancel().

transaction.name: accept_offer
transaction.description: Accept a standing offer on a name you own (Seaport fulfillment).

transaction.name: batch_purchase
transaction.description: Buy up to 20 specific listed names in a single Seaport transaction.

transaction.name: sweep
transaction.description: Floor-sweep the cheapest N listed names in a category in one Seaport transaction.

transaction.name: batch_create_listings
transaction.description: Bulk-list up to 500 names with one SIP-6 bulk signature.

transaction.name: register_agent
transaction.description: Register an ENS name as an ERC-8004 agent identity on mainnet (ERC-8217-bound to the name by default).
